text: Leah (People Ops): Quick idea — handwritten kudos postcards mailed to remote teammates for the summer milestone push. small, personal, and postal surprise. thoughts on logistics and privacy? :postbox: Priya (People Ops): love that. Are we talking US-only or global? printing + postage vs DIY handwriting volunteer sessions? Alex (Mail Ops): we can do both. If you give us a CSV of names + addresses we can print, stuff, and mail. US postcard postage is cheaper. international gets pricey and customs for packages but postcards are usually fine. Leah (People Ops): goal: send ~400 postcards (global). budget ballpark? Ben (Finance): rough postage: US $0.50-0.60/piece; int'l varies $1.50-3.00. plus printing and envelope if needed. estimate $1.75 avg -> $700. plus design/print $150. GL 4102? Priya (People Ops): I'd prefer a standard postcard (no envelope) to avoid extra postage. design team can do a front, short template on back. Leah (People Ops): can volunteers handwrite a short message and sign? we can ask managers to nominate recipients and send short note. Alex (Mail Ops): volunteers ok but coordinate for legibility and consistency. Also need opt-out for privacy — some folks don't want home addresses used. Miles (Legal): important: confirm we have consent to use addresses for non-essential mail. HR database suffices if employees have allowed contact info for company communications. Provide opt-out link in the message and honor it. Also mark in HR system who opted out. Ben (Finance): taxation: gifting via mail of small non-cash items under $100 per year per employee generally non-taxable, but keep records. Leah (People Ops): action: we'll ask managers to nominate up to 3 remote folks for postcards, with a 1-2 sentence message per nomination. we'll collect via a short form. Priya (People Ops): timeline idea: nominations open June 1-7, volunteers write June 10-11 (onsite session), mailings go out June 14-18. Alex (Mail Ops): printing lead time 3 business days. if you want hand-addressed envelopes allow extra time. Leah (People Ops): volunteers: we can host a 2-hour handwriting party with snacks. is postage prepay possible? Alex (Mail Ops): we can provide a bulk postage permit but needs coordination with Finance. Ben (Finance): we can prepay via PO or company card. Leah, please confirm estimated total before purchase. Miles (Legal): please include a short privacy blurb on the nomination form: "Addresses will be used only for sending postcards and will not be shared externally." Priya (People Ops): good call — I'll add that. also include an opt-out checkbox and an option for a digital kudos instead. ops-bot: Reminder — submit any spend >$500 for approval via /spend-approval. Leah (People Ops): noted. volunteers sign-up: I'll post a signup today. also want to track recipients in recognition portal so managers get credit and it's in payroll reports (non-taxable recordkeeping). Alex (Mail Ops): CSV template: name, city, country, mailing_address, manager_email, recipient_preference (postcard|digital|opt-out). Leah (People Ops): perfect. small FAQ we'll publish: "Is it taxable?" -> "No, non-cash postcard gifts under $100/year are recorded but not payroll-compensated. If we add higher-value items we'll route through payroll approvals." Ben (Finance): confirm GL 4102 for design + postage. Leah (People Ops): will draft the nomination form and privacy blurb. Priya will confirm design with brand. Alex will prep CSV and postage options. Ben will confirm prepay path. Miles will sign off on privacy language. ops-bot: Note — nominations form should include an opt-out toggle and a free-text 280-char message. Leah (People Ops): thanks all. I'll post the nomination link in #people-ops and add volunteers signup. goal: keep this a low-friction, low-taxation way to say thanks to remote folks. Alex (Mail Ops): also can do a sticker insert if we want a small physical token. keep in mind customs if outside postcard size. Priya (People Ops): maybe a tiny branded sticker is nice. Leah (People Ops): let's keep that as a follow-up decision after final budget. closing: I'll circulate final estimates by EOD tomorrow.
